name: Naga
body:
Source Pathfinder RPG Bestiary pg. 211
 This family represents a group of similar monsters. No official description was provided.
Members
Dark Naga (CR 8), Deep Naga (CR 12), Dream Naga (CR 9), Guardian Naga (CR 10), Lunar Naga (CR 6), Royal Naga (CR 11), Slime Naga (CR 9), Spirit Naga (CR 9), Water Naga (CR 7)
